title: Yummy Mediterranean Almond Tagine
description: A nutty, tender, kid-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring udon noodles in a fragrant tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until onion soft and translucent.
Stir in sliced tomatoes and chopped almonds; cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, add chickpeas, oregano, paprika, salt, and lemon juice; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and let the mixture simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
While sauce simmers, boil udon noodles in salted water for 4 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Remove the tagine from heat and fold in the cooked udon noodles, ensuring noodles are coated with the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of toasted almonds and a squeeze of fresh lemon if desired.
